title: Deterministic non-coding domain suite (finance, trade, sustainability, governance, grounded extraction)
description: Seeded business-rule cases graded by code oracles, not by a judge model. Families: Singapore carbon tax + GHG Scope 2; CFO-office finance (GST, NPV, loan annuity, IFRS 16 initial measurement, budget variance); UCP 600 letter-of-credit examination and Incoterms 2020 risk allocation; procurement controls (delegation of authority, three-way match, segregation of duties) and PDPA breach notification; grounded extraction with verbatim-quote checks. Every case carries abstention probes and metamorphic twins. Rule parameters and their provenance live in minder_domain_evals/rulebook.py. Seeds >= 1000 are the holdout split. The committed fixture is a small dev sample; any (seed, n) regenerates byte-identically.

tasks.title: Oracles pass themselves, every mutant fails, hand-worked anchors hold (tests/test_domain_evals.py)
Reference answers replay through the grader at 100% on the committed dev sample
Local model through the minder proxy: python -m minder_domain_evals run/score; compare reports with minder-op benchmark compare
